greet.text: An elf in a leaf-green apron behind a stall of jars, bundles and stoppered vials, the Lantern Gardens' light catching in every one. "Tamsin Leafwright. Herbs, tinctures, arrows for the forest floor, and a tome or two the Veil College would rather I kept for its own students. Look all you like."

floor.text: "The boughs are safe. The floor has boars, and worse when the Wanderer's dark." She shrugs. "Elves who never climb down don't think about it. I sell to the ones who do."
